enchantments.tooltip: Fortification +75%: This suit of armor or shield produces a magical force that protects vital areas of the wearer much more effectively. When a critical hit or sneak attack is scored on the wearer, there is a 75% chance that the critical hit or sneak attack is negated and damage is instead rolled normally.
Rune Arm Imbue: Fire I: Wearing this Rune Arm will imbue any weapon you wield, dealing 1d4 points of fire damage per hit.
This Rune Arm is craftable and can be customized using recipes at standard crafting devices after disjuncting.
